Hi Hollis. I can't set up this recurring 08:30 digest from here. My tools in this workspace let me read and post messages, but they have no way to schedule a post or run on a timer. If I said it was set, nothing would appear tomorrow.

You're a member of both #central-team and #inc-tansley-carrier-api, so I can read them for you. Here are two ways to get the digest:

- **On request:** Ask me in #central-team any weekday morning, for example "standup prep". I'll post the open items from both channels since the last digest.
- **Automatic:** An admin could set up a scheduled trigger that wakes me at 08:30 on weekdays. I can then do the rest.

Which do you want? If you'd like a first digest now, say so and I'll post it.
